title: table top cherry tree
text:
table top cherry tree. I liked this because the battery has a timer option. So it comes on with my candles and off at the same time. It has a lovely soft glow. In the photo I have provided, it is in front of mirror... so you see the reflection of the tree behind. The flowers are a soft, yellowish glow. The flowers themselves are a silicone like material, not hard plastic. There is a slight plastic odor, but I am pretty sure that will dissipate over time. It's about 2' tall.. the branches spread and bend nicely. The branches are taped wrapped and it is black. Not sure about the black yet... the base is black metal and there is a battery box. So you'll need to hide that, that's why I have it behind my weather gauge. It came with some batteries... AA. You have the option of on, off or timer - which I believe is 6 hours on or maybe 5, 18 or 19 hours off.
I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful. And I hope my photo and info where helpful to you!

product_metadata.title: Bright Zeal 18" LED Cherry Blossom Tree Light with Timer - Battery Operated LED Lighted Flower Table Top - Lighted Bonsai Tree Table Lamp Modern Home Decor - Lit Tree Centerpieces Indoor Decor BZY
features: CHERRY TREE LIGHT BRINGS SPRING HOME 365 DAYS A YEAR - Featuring a unique bonsai style design with adjustable branches and a natural tree shape, this 18” LED cherry tree light is embellished with 48 LED crystal-like cherry blossom petals that look stunningly elegant when lit at night - Remind you of the refreshing scent of spring as well as create a warm festival ambiance to any space - Explore interesting holiday and daily decor options for your house and work space.

ADJUSTABLE BRANCHES & EASY-DECORATING - Satisfy your personal DIY needs with adjustable branches - Bend the branches and twigs into the shape you like - Spread the branches apart for a full bloom; or cluster them together for a sleek silhouette - Truly nice as a centerpiece for tables for a soft, magical effect, or a modern indoor home decor - Enhance any party, dinner, or use as a decorative lamp - Ideal for wedding ceremony, Christmas, New Year, parties, dinner party decorations.

SIX-HOUR TIMER - The light features an ON/TIMER/OFF switch, allowing you to turn the light on and off, or choose a timer function to have it go on and off automatically - On the TIMER position, the light can be left on for 6 hours and then remains off for 18 hours, only to light up again for another 6 hours automatically - When the timer is not in use, just turn ON or OFF the tree light as a regular light.

BATTERY OPERATED & SAFE - Each light requires 3 AA batteries (included) - No wires to hide and no extension cords snaking up the wall - The metal stand with 4 cushions provides a stable base for long-term display without being tipped over or scratching the table surfaces - The trunk and branches are wrapped in electrical tapes, no safety hazards - Long lasting LED bulbs stay cool to touch after long-time use, not easy to scald.

DEVOTED CUSTOMER SERVICE - This product comes with 1-MONTH full refund trial period and LIFE-TIME customer service - Genuine BRIGHT ZEAL home LED light products - Certified under UL588 and Complies with 16 CFR 1120.3(c) - TRADEMARK filed in U.S.A. - In business since 1997.
